title: perula benghalensis
intro: Perula benghalensis, commonly known as the Bengal tree, is a species of tree native to tropical regions of Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain relief, as well as its potential to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Perula benghalensis include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been shown to have therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, alleviating respiratory issues, and treating skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Perula benghalensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
